context: Setting up a personal attention brief starts from what the machine and workspace show, then asks the user one question with options and a recommendation, and writes no skill on guessed sources. Judge response.md and every file written.

checklist.name: Looks before asking
checklist.description: The reply reflects what the workspace shows: the GitHub and GitLab repositories from projects.json and the Atlassian and Slack MCP servers from .mcp.json. A reply that ignores these files scores at most 5

checklist.name: One question, with options and a recommendation
checklist.description: response.md asks exactly one question now, offers concrete options grounded in what was found, recommends one, and says further questions follow its answer. Two or more questions asked at once, or a numbered questionnaire, scores at most 8; a question without options or a recommendation scores at most 12

checklist.name: No skill on guesses
checklist.description: No howdy SKILL.md with a finished source list is written yet; sources, accounts, and what counts as needing the user wait for the answers. A finished skill built on guessed or placeholder sources scores 0

checklist.name: Says where it will live
checklist.description: Names the target as skills/howdy/ in this workspace

checklist.name: Short
checklist.description: response.md is brief and leads with the question or a one-line state, without a long preamble
